info.name: StudentDetailsAPITest
info.description:
This collection is designed to test the Student Details API by validating the creation, retrieval, update, and enrichment of student records.

It includes requests to:
- retrieve all student records
- create a new student
- fetch a specific student by ID
- update an existing student record
- create technical skills data for a student
- create address details linked to a student
- retrieve final student details using the combined student information

The collection supports end-to-end API testing by using reusable environment variables such as `{{base_url}}` and `{{Student_id}}` to chain requests across the student data workflow.
